text: Photography is a form of art that captures the world around us with light and dark shadows. Aperture is a crucial aspect of photography, controlling how much light is allowed to enter the camera. It affects the depth of field and the amount of background blur. Shutter speed is the duration of time that the camera's shutter is open, and it also impacts the amount of light captured. The combination of aperture and shutter speed creates a well-lit scene. Understanding aperture and shutter speed are essential skills for capturing clear and vibrant images.
